title: Audit Report: Global Fund Grants in the Republic of South Sudan (GF-OIG-19-021)
publisher: The Global Fund, Office of the Inspector General
why_not: States only the 2019 position: the DHIS1.4 to DHIS2 transition for County Health Directorates postponed to December 2020. County-level entry is already held at a later date, and it names no funder, tier in use or clinic count for the gaps.
